name: James Meyers
description: Born June 2003. Appears throughout the 2017–2018 journals in car rides, lego league, NSP musical rehearsals. Good relationship. Now 22.
bio: Youngest sibling. Quiet, introspective, empathetic, encyclopedic recall of geography and history. Fluent in Spanish by 2022. Lost significant weight 2018–2020 through sustained effort. Graduated SUNY Potsdam 2025 with a BA in English Writing, then enrolled in SUNY Canton nursing program. Active in the church college ministry, respected for kindness and dependability.
